title: The US-led Iran bombing campaign causes longer delivery times for Amazon, Shein, and others in the Middle East, one of the fastest-growing e-commerce markets (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: The US-led Iran bombing campaign causes longer delivery times for Amazon, Shein, and others in the Middle East, one of the fastest-growing e-commerce markets — Major e-commerce platforms are warning of longer delivery times to the Middle East after the US-led bombing campaign …
